worldcombat.skill.acidspray.summary: Spray a short, wide acid mist: every enemy in the wedge takes special damage and immediately loses 2 stages of Sp. Def, and it disperses at once with no lingering damage or repeated drops. Spray in a free direction at close range or pick an entity; an empty spray still plays. The focused nozzle is narrower and longer; the wide spray covers a whole group.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.use.0: Strip two stages of Sp. Def off a group in front at close range
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.use.1: Grind Sp. Def with the cheapest possible cast
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.use.2: Spray the chokepoint as foes try to push through
The mist hits each enemy it drenches for about %1$s special damage and lowers its Sp. Def by %2$s stage(s).
The mist covers a %1$s-block, %2$s-degree wedge in front; it disperses at once with no lingering damage and no repeated drop.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.focus.on: Focused nozzle: range %1$s blocks and only a %2$s-degree opening, for naming one target.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.focus.off: Wide spray: a %1$s-block, %2$s-degree wedge drenches several foes at once.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.growth.0: From level %1$s the spray rises to %2$s power and %3$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.preference.f: On: opening cut to 55% and range ×1.3 with no extra power or cooldown cost — for naming one target. Off (wide): the widest opening, drenching several foes in front at once.
worldcombat.skill.acidspray.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first. Larger values let it approach from further away before spraying.
On: the more enemies in range still at full Sp. Def, the higher it ranks the spray, opening the way for the team's special attackers. Off: it sorts like an ordinary attack.
